description: This file defines types and functions related to managing the runtime context for embedded compaction in an agent system, including resolving target configurations and building context objects.

methods.name: resolveEmbeddedCompactionTarget
methods.description: Resolves the effective compaction target provider and model from configuration, with support for overrides and defaults.

methods.name: buildEmbeddedCompactionRuntimeContext
methods.description: Constructs a runtime context object for embedded compaction, resolving configuration and setting default values.
